description: Look up one step of a guided journey by its id, its title or its position: its title, where it sits in the journey, its timer in minutes when the step has one, and the link that opens it. The instructions themselves are on the page, where the timer for that step runs.

slug.description: Journey identifier, e.g. "sourdough-bread", or the journey's title.

step.description: Step identifier (e.g. "mix"), its title, or position ("5" is the fifth step). Left out, the first step is returned.

name: get_sourdough_journey_step

outputSchema.description: One step of a guided journey.

input.description: The arguments as the tool used them, after any correction.

note.description: A remark on the whole result, such as why nothing was found.

notes.description: What was corrected or left out, such as a value outside its range.

position.description: Where it sits, such as "3 of 14".

timer_minutes.description: Its timer, when the step has one.

url.description: The same answer, recipe or entry on loafy.ai.

title: Look up a journey step
